name: limit_configuration_that_does_not_exist
why: THE RED OF `activate_configuration`. `ShowConfiguration2` on a name that is not there answers FALSE and nothing else: no exception, no message, the document stays where it was. An operation that did not look at the return value would say «done» and leave the plan drawing on the variant from before -- and in the finished file there would be nothing to notice it by.
_why_the_message_lists: «I cannot find the configuration Right» is half of the answer; the other half is which ones there are, because almost always the right name is there written in a way the caller did not expect -- with angle brackets inside, for example.
